name: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi
summary: Tata Memorial Centre cancer hospital near Varanasi Cantt, the sister unit of the Mahamana cancer centre at BHU.
description: Official facts gathered (publish once a photo is added): Tata Memorial Centre / DAE unit; formerly the Indian Railway Cancer Hospital; running since 1 May 2018 with 179 beds; near Varanasi Cantt station; works with MPMMCC under one Director; phone (0542) 2517699. Sources: mpmmcc.tmc.gov.in, tmc.gov.in. [ADD FIRST-HAND] photo of the building.
